def find_path(graph, start, goal):
    frontier = [[start]]
    explored = set()
    while frontier:
        path = frontier.pop(0)
        node = path[-1]
        if node == goal:
            return path
        if node not in explored:
            explored.add(node)
            neighbors = graph[node]
            for neighbor in neighbors:
                new_path = list(path)
                new_path.append(neighbor)
                frontier.append(new_path)
    return None
